name: OrderShield Checkout Blocker for WooCommerce
author: Saubhik M

sections.description:
OrderShield Checkout Blocker for WooCommerce allows store administrators to prevent customers from placing orders using specific email addresses or IPv4 addresses.

The plugin provides a simple settings page where administrators can manage blocked email addresses and IP addresses.

When a customer attempts to place an order using a blocked email address or IP address, the checkout is prevented and an error message is displayed.

Features

  • Block orders by email address.
  • Block orders by IPv4 address.
  • Manage blocked email addresses from the WordPress admin.
  • Manage blocked IP addresses from the WordPress admin.
  • Validate email addresses before saving.
  • Validate IPv4 addresses before saving.
  • WooCommerce dependency detection.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Go to Settings > OrderShield Checkout Blocker for WooCommerce.
  5. Add the email addresses or IPv4 addresses you want to block.
  6. Save your settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Can I block customers by email address?

Yes. Add one email address per line in the plugin settings.

Can I block customers by IP address?

Yes. The plugin supports IPv4 addresses.

Can I add multiple email addresses?

Yes. Add one email address per line.

Can I add multiple IP addresses?

Yes. Add one IPv4 address per line.
